name: Clop
description: Clop (also written Cl0p) is a Russian ransomware-as-a-service cybercriminal organization that has extorted over $500 million in ransom payments. The group is known for large-scale supply chain attacks exploiting zero-day vulnerabilities, including the 2021 Accellion FTA attack and the 2023 MOVEit Transfer attack that compromised hundreds of organizations including US government agencies.
